name: human-fsm
description: Slash commands for the human's side of the rainlanguage issue→PR pipeline finite state machine: the reads that precede a ruling and the transitions that make it. Each command is one invocation of pr-review-report — the guards (vocabulary, mandatory note, provenance anchor, stranded-flag refusal, subject type, terminal-is-moot, idempotence) live in that binary, not here.
